title: gymnadenia odoratissima var. pyrenaica
intro: Gymnadenia odoratissima var. pyrenaica, commonly known as the Pyrenean fragrant orchid, is a plant species that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. This plant has been used for its medicinal properties, particularly for its potential health benefits in treating respiratory issues, such as coughs and colds, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Gymnadenia odoratissima var. pyrenaica include its ability to reduce inflammation, relieve coughs, and ease congestion, making it a potential treatment for respiratory infections. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include iridoids and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
